tests.expected: cùng ID ở 2 DN không trộn
tests.observed: Company/tenant scoped upload, report, commit and snapshot queries; foreign IDs on authorized route return 404 without records.

tests.expected: chứng từ đến muộn không đổi feature as_of cũ
tests.observed: Source known-time fields preserved and existing as_of helper tested, but snapshot-to-feature replay integration still pending.

tests.expected: preview đổi file/mapping không commit bằng report cũ
tests.observed: Changing source/mapping creates a new draft revision and clears preview; old revision/hashes/validator/permission context rejected; hashes cannot be forged.

tests.expected: retry import 10 lần vẫn một snapshot đã commit
tests.observed: Ten sequential and concurrent retries produce one snapshot and one commit event; durable receipt survives restart/response loss; injected mid-transaction failure rolls back.

tests.expected: âm điều chỉnh/thiếu history phân loại đúng; không âm thầm bỏ dòng
tests.observed: Signed adjustments and missing-source limitations preserved; raw source/mapping/reports and validated dataset retained, no silently dropped rows.

tests.expected: Cùng timestamp: 2 khoản đồng thời đều dùng lịch sử trước nhóm, replay đảo thứ tự không đổi feature
tests.observed: Atomic import concurrency is tested; simultaneous feature-history replay is a separate unimplemented integration.

tests.expected: User DN A gọi import/preview/commit/snapshot của B bị từ chối ở API; 0 record B trả về
tests.observed: Upload/source/mapping/preview/commit/report/snapshot/data all check company permission before body/storage; direct foreign IDs do not expose records; revocation before and at transaction exit rolls back.
